notes: No list in this election was an alliance of separate parties. Mizrachi and Hapoel HaMizrachi ran separately in 1951; in 1961 the NRP and Liberal Party were already merged parties, while Agudat Yisrael and Poalei Agudat Yisrael ran separately.
